description: First PPO-facing trading/state text feature set. These are not document-quality fields; they are intended to describe market/company/portfolio state extracted from text.

features.name: text_relevance_to_portfolio
features.meaning: How relevant the document is for the portfolio/ticker.

features.name: sentiment_direction
features.meaning: Overall financial tone: negative, neutral, positive.

features.name: price_impact_direction
features.meaning: Expected directional pressure from the document, not a trading decision.

features.name: risk_intensity
features.meaning: Strength of downside risk discussed or introduced by the document.

features.name: uncertainty_intensity
features.meaning: Amount of uncertainty, conditionality, volatility, or unclear outlook.

features.name: opportunity_intensity
features.meaning: Strength of upside, growth, margin, demand, buyback, or dividend opportunity.

features.name: forward_looking_intensity
features.meaning: Amount of guidance, outlook, expectation, or future-looking content.

features.name: earnings_guidance_impact
features.meaning: Impact of earnings, revenue, EPS, margins, or guidance.

features.name: macro_financial_conditions_impact
features.meaning: Impact of rates, credit, inflation, volatility, labor, energy, or broad macro conditions.

features.name: company_event_risk_impact
features.meaning: Impact of legal, regulatory, supply-chain, demand, margin, or company-specific risk.
